definitions.explanation: a low flame or heat setting used in cooking, typically for simmering or slow cooking

examples.japanese: {弱火|よわび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
{弱火|よわび}にして⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Turn to low heat and cover with a lid.

examples.japanese: {弱火|よわび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二十分|にじゅっぷん}⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧。
examples.english: Simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焦|こ}げない→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弱火|よわび}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn it to low heat so it doesn't burn.

examples.japanese: {弱火|よわび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦じっくり→じっくり：06252_jikkuri⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧。

notes:
HEAT LEVELS IN COOKING:
- {弱火|よわび} (low heat)
- ⟦{中火|ちゅうび}→中火：08169_chuubi⟧ (medium heat)
- ⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧ (high heat)
- ⟦とろ{火|び}→とろ火：08577_torobi⟧ (very low/simmering heat)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {弱火|よわび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to turn to low heat)
- {弱火|よわび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧ (to simmer on low heat)
- {弱火|よわび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ (to sauté on low heat)

USAGE:
Used frequently in recipes and cooking instructions. Essential for dishes requiring slow cooking or preventing burning.
